Around [[3642 BBY]], [[Darth Baras]]'s [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] was assigned to '''eliminate''' the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] leading strategists of the [[War Trust]]. With [[Plan Zero]] enacted, Darth Baras was assigned by his [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] [[Darth Vengean]] to eliminate the Republic's military leaders in preparation for the coming [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Baras ordered his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], recently promoted to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], to travel to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and eliminate four of these military leaders, who comprised the War Trust.
